facts: The research used machine learning techniques.
The research involved building a comma checker.
The comma checker is to be integrated in a grammar checker for Basque.
The system was trained with a little corpus of 100,000 words.
In the task of not placing commas, the system achieved a precision of 96%.
In the task of not placing commas, the system achieved a recall of 98%.
In the task of placing commas, the system achieved a precision of 70%.
In the task of placing commas, the system achieved a recall of 49%.
These results can be improved using a bigger and a more homogeneous corpus to train.
A bigger and more homogeneous corpus is a bigger corpus written by one unique author.
The grammar checker is for Basque.
The system guesses correctly not placing commas.
